name: single-post
label: Single Post
brief:
One image with one short line, understood in under a second. The line is what people save or send, so it has to feel instantly true to them.
- Pick the angle that fits the idea: mood (a feeling they know, saves), fact (an everyday truth they can't deny, shares), motivational (a push to act, saves, follows).
- Write the line as people would say it: specific, a little unexpected, never a slogan or a generic quote.
- The illustration shows the subject of the line, playful and readable at a glance; it supports the line, it doesn't explain it.
- Caption: one short paragraph that adds a layer of meaning or a small story behind the line, without repeating it. No call to action.

content.text: The one line on the image, max 12 words
content.decoration: Inline SVG illustration of the line's subject: one <svg> with a viewBox, a few bold rounded shapes in a simple doodle style, colors only through var(--art-line), var(--art-paper) and var(--art-fill), no text, at most 20 elements

format.caption: Hook in the first 125 characters, no hashtags

content.text: I'll be nice in one cup
